def harmonic_sum(n):
    """Write a function to calculate the harmonic sum of n-1."""
    # Add reciprocals one at a time in increasing order. This sequential
    # floating-point addition reproduces the conventional result; the
    # built-in sum() may use compensated summation and differ by 1 ulp.
    total = 0.0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        total += 1.0 / i
    return total
